name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan's journey into motorsport started unexpectedly, during his mandatory military service. Stationed near a small karting track, the roar of engines sparked an unshakeable passion. He pursued mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, and landed his first role with a touring car team in the late 90s. His pragmatic approach and eye for detail quickly earned him recognition. 

Before joining Scuderia Ferrari, Ivan honed his skills at a smaller Formula team, where limited resources forced him to be incredibly innovative and efficient. He believes in data-driven decisions, coupled with an intuitive understanding of airflow. Ivan is known for his ability to translate complex aerodynamic concepts into practical, track-ready solutions, making him a valuable asset in the high-pressure world of Formula 1.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky man with a perpetually serious expression, Ivan exudes an air of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn aerodynamic sketches.
Refuses to use digital whiteboards, preferring traditional chalkboards for brainstorming sessions.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, driving some colleagues crazy.
